project_overview: Team Dashboard & Notes Platform featuring a free-form draggable canvas workspace, real-time chat, and robust file/note management. The aesthetic blends Swiss Brutalism with modern tactile elements, focusing on high contrast, stark layouts, and physical window manipulation.

theme.vibe: Tactile, functional, precise, and highly customizable. It should feel like a physical desk with the power of an infinite digital command center.

typography.secondary_font_usage: Body, Chat text, Notes content, UI labels

colors.notes: Color is function. Avoid gradient overload. The canvas background should feature a subtle 1px dot grid pattern in both modes to emphasize the 'workspace' feel. Red is strictly for primary actions, unread indicators, and active states.

layouts.app_shell: 100vh 100vw hidden overflow. The canvas is the scrollable/draggable area.
layouts.header: Fixed at top, z-50. Height: 64px. Contains Multi-org Switcher (left), Global Search (center), Refresh, Activity Bell, Profile (right).
layouts.sidebar_left: Collapsible. Width: 280px. Houses Navigation: Home Canvas, Shared Library, Chat, Calendar, Settings.
layouts.canvas_area: Takes remaining calc(100vh - 64px). Infinite pan/zoom or fixed draggable boundary using react-rnd.

canvas_workspace.description: The core signature experience. A massive grid background where users pin windows.
canvas_workspace.tech_recommendation: Use `react-rnd` (React Resize and Drag) for the windows. Manage window coordinates in state.
canvas_workspace.styling: Background must have a CSS radial-gradient or repeating-linear-gradient to create a dot matrix or grid overlay. Windows should have absolute positioning driven by state.

draggable_windows.description: Cards acting as files/notes on the canvas.
draggable_windows.styling: Cardless aesthetic. 0px or 2px border radius. Sharp 1px solid border (uses --user-window-border variable). In light mode, crisp box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.1) for a slight neo-brutalist pop. Drag handle should be a subtle top bar on hover.
draggable_windows.states: Active/Focused window comes to front (highest z-index), border color changes to Primary Red.

notes_editor.styling: Clean, minimal toolbar. Whiteboard toggle reveals a canvas element. Use standard Shadcn dropdowns for formatting.
notes_editor.tech_recommendation: Use `@tiptap/react` for text, `tldraw` or standard canvas API for the lightweight whiteboard.

chat_panel.description: Team channel and DMs. Can be a pinned window or side drawer.
chat_panel.styling: Message bubbles should not be bubbly. Sharp rectangles. Different background for @mentions (Navy or Red tint). Avatar on the left.

header_bar.styling: Solid background. 1px bottom border. Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for the header. Org switcher uses a heavy typography dropdown.

permissions_screen.styling: Dense, data-heavy grid. Use Shadcn Switch/Toggles. No generic cards; use a strict table-like row layout with borders separating users.

motion.window_drag: No transition on transform while dragging to prevent lag. Transition on box-shadow to appear 'lifted' (shadow-2xl) while active.
motion.hover_states: Crisp, instantaneous color swaps. No mushy 0.3s transitions. Use 0.1s ease-out.
motion.popups: Scale-in from 0.95 to 1, opacity 0 to 1 over 150ms.

media_and_images.icons: Use `lucide-react`. Stroke width 1.5 or 2 based on density.
media_and_images.instructions: Use avatars for team members and chat. Use the abstract vivid gradient in dark mode settings panels or premium empty states. Use the minimalist grey texture as an optional user-selected canvas background.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast ratio. Navy on Light Grey, White on Deep Navy.
accessibility.keyboard: Canvas items must be focusable. Implement basic keyboard nudging (arrow keys) for focused canvas windows.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, menu items, window headers, tabs) MUST have `data-testid` attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent.dependencies: Run: yarn add react-rnd lucide-react @tiptap/react @tiptap/starter-kit clsx tailwind-merge date-fns sonner
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_components: Install standard shadcn components: button, input, dialog, dropdown-menu, switch, tabs, avatar, scroll-area, popover.
instructions_to_main_agent.canvas_implementation: Create a `Canvas` component wrapping `react-rnd` elements. Maintain an array of nodes (id, x, y, width, height, type, content) in React state. Update state `onDragStop` and `onResizeStop` to avoid lag.
instructions_to_main_agent.customization_engine: Implement a hook or context that injects CSS variables to the document root or canvas container for background color, border width, and text luminance.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold. Make it feel tactile and sharp.
DO NOT center align the app container. `.App { text-align: center; }` is forbidden.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, particularly for draggable windows.
Never use generic AI emojis (🤖, 💡, 🎯). Use lucide-react icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing for forms and padding inside notes, but keep chat dense and readable.
Every window, button, and input MUST have a `data-testid` like `data-testid="org-switcher-dropdown"`.
Always apply hover states to interactive elements. Ensure focus states have higher contrast.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals over the canvas.
